verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a vendor-maintained integrations catalog of 1,000+ tools, including cloud services such as Amazon API Gateway and Alibaba Cloud, and community users confirm a first-party Datadog agent that was easy to configure. The evidence is mostly titles and directory listings, so host, container and Kubernetes instrumentation is implied rather than shown. One user also notes language gaps, such as no Datadog SDK for Elixir/Erlang. missing for 10: explicit documentation of host, container and Kubernetes agent instrumentation (the Kubernetes evidence covers only autoscaling), cloud-provider integration depth beyond directory listings, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent deployment across these environments.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations
